title: A software factory for an iOS team: Linux orchestration, Mac implementation
summary: Ben Holmes describes a three-person iOS team keeping orchestration and review agents on Linux while a Mac-based implementer builds, exercises the Simulator, and returns screenshots or recordings. Slack makes tasks and design feedback visible to the team, and adversarial review repeats as changes are refined; an iOS team can require both visual evidence and review before accepting a feature, while making prototype exceptions explicit.
takeaway: Keep native build and Simulator verification on a Mac, return screenshots or recordings to a shared review channel, and repeat adversarial review after feedback before accepting a production change.
